items.headline: Chabad of Sunnyvale seeks permit for Fremont Avenue site
items.summary: The September 30 Zoning Administrator agenda listed a use permit for a religious institution in an existing commercial building at 645 W. Fremont Avenue, owned by Chabad of Sunnyvale and zoned R-1 for low-density residential use.

items.headline: Nvidia gets permit for server rack installation
items.summary: A permit was issued for an R&D lab rack installation at 300 Holger Way, with a declared permit valuation of $1,664,913.

items.headline: Coleman Avenue buildings permitted for solar systems
items.summary: Commercial/industrial PV system permits were issued for 555 Coleman Avenue and 561 Coleman Avenue, with declared permit valuations of $800,000 and $600,000 respectively.

items.headline: Council closed session included City Attorney appointment
items.summary: The same closed session agenda included a public employee appointment item for the position of City Attorney.

items.headline: Hearing Set on 408-Unit Project on El Camino Real
items.summary: A public hearing was scheduled on prezoning, annexation, and a tentative subdivision map for a 408-unit residential development at 451-475 El Camino Real, with an Environmental Impact Report prepared under state environmental law.

items.headline: Council closed session on Cubberley Site negotiations with PAUSD
items.summary: The September 22 City Council closed session agenda listed real property negotiations over the Cubberley Site at 4000 Middlefield Road with the Palo Alto Unified School District, covering possible purchase, exchange, or lease terms. No outcome of the closed session was included in the agenda.

items.headline: Parks Commission to review playground synthetic turf rules
items.summary: The Parks and Recreation Commission's September 22 agenda included a review of proposed guidelines for synthetic turf use on playgrounds, plus a staff recommendation on the Foothills Nature Preserve Improvement Project (PE-21000).
